meta.script: scratchpad lo_extract.py: ranges Inputs E, Tender E5:J88 and E176:AQ227, Deposits E6:AH19, Devex_FEP E3:T39, MOIC (blocks 1-11, 16), HTM rows 4-14/35-48/55/90-92, Run_Map C22:C33, Calc G305:DH305; plus MOIC G164, G171, G174, G212, G213, G217, G220 (developer block)

1.Inputs!E8: FEP funds 100%, 70/30 JV on proceeds, 200 MW, aligned to BORA Devex 29/09/2026
1.Tender!F27: lost % of total = overbuild ÷ (1 + overbuild) × this rate; drives row 45 (generation, HTM E36) and the RtB price effect (row 214)
1.Tender!F28: Physical effect of the overbuild (row 43), so it applies in every scenario; set on the Control Panel
1.Tender!F30: 100 % = the buyer deducts the full PV of the promises relative to the S1 current-bid reference (promises below it, e.g. S0, add to the price); set on the Control Panel
1.Tender!F31: Tender XII.2 – security returned 6 months after COD (as v5)
1.Tender!F32: Used by the check rows (section 7, Deposits)
1.Tender!F34: × Inputs E20 (BESS MW) → MOIC G143 and the gross RtB premium (row 220)
1.Tender!F224: Municipal, BESS and security are paid by FEP before COD (HTM block 17)
1.Deposits!E8: % of combined benchmark CAPEX (wind + BESS), gross
1.Deposits!E9: % of benchmark CAPEX on failed wind capacity
1.Deposits!E10: % of combined benchmark CAPEX (wind + BESS), post-award, x uplift
1.Devex_FEP!M4: Principal earning 20 % (H + K if Inputs E67 = 1, k€; M3 = rate)
1.Devex_FEP!N4: Segment 1 to the RtB sale (F → N3 = MIN(sale, pause start))
1.Devex_FEP!O4: Segment 2 start = MAX(F, O3 = pause end)
1.Devex_FEP!P4: Segment 2 to the RtB sale (O → P3 = Inputs E58)
1.Devex_FEP!Q4: Segment 1 to the COD sale (F → Q3)
1.Devex_FEP!R4: Segment 2 to the COD sale (O → R3 = Inputs E155)
1.Devex_FEP!S4: Multiple to the RtB sale = MAX(N × P, 2×)
1.Devex_FEP!T4: Multiple to the COD sale = MAX(Q × R, 2×)
